title.zh: 一个羧基，不是两个独立官能团
title.en: A carboxyl group is one functional group

text.zh: 羧酸的标志是同一个碳同时连羰基氧和OH：—C(=O)OH，常简写成—COOH。这里的OH属于羧基；不能仅看到OH就把整个分子判成醇。COOH中有一个碳，数主链时必须包含它。
text.en: A carboxylic acid has C=O and OH on the same carbon: —C(=O)OH, often condensed as —COOH. Its OH is part of the carboxyl group, and its carbon must be counted in the parent.

text.zh: 羧酸分子有极性，羧基能参与氢键。因此与相近大小的烃相比，分子间作用通常更强。较小羧酸较易溶于水；烃链变长后，非极性部分的影响变大，水溶性通常下降。羧酸是弱酸，不代表没有酸性。
text.en: Carboxylic acids are polar and participate in hydrogen bonding. Intermolecular attractions are stronger than in comparable hydrocarbons. Water solubility generally decreases as the hydrocarbon chain grows; a weak acid is still acidic.

title.zh: 羧基碳一号：先选母体，再数支链

text.zh: 单羧基开链酸先找COOH，再找包含羧基碳的最长碳链，从羧基碳开始编号。图画成弯折，主链仍可沿真实连接转弯；不能只数横排的几个字母。母体碳数与全分子碳数是两个不同数字。
text.en: For an acyclic monocarboxylic acid, choose the longest carbon chain including the carboxyl carbon and number from that carbon. The parent can bend in the drawing. Parent carbon count is not total molecular carbon count.

title.zh: 制备：伯醇 → 醛 → 羧酸

text.zh: 本节用乙醇说明两段氧化：CH₃CH₂OH + [O] → CH₃CHO + H₂O；CH₃CHO + [O] → CH₃COOH。保留两个碳的连接，变化的是含氧官能团。[O]表示净氧化当量，不是自由氧原子或实验操作步骤。
text.en: Ethanol is oxidized to ethanal, then to ethanoic acid. The two-carbon framework remains. [O] represents an oxidation equivalent, not a free oxygen atom or a practical experimental procedure.

title.zh: 换词根不换碳链：甲醇、丙醇和丁醛
title.en: Retain the carbon framework in oxidation examples

concepts.reference: 教材p62 Sample / p63 Example、Practice5；原创方程归纳

text.zh: 甲醇到甲酸：CH₃OH + [O] → HCHO + H₂O；HCHO + [O] → HCOOH。名称依次methanol、methanal（formaldehyde）、methanoic acid（formic acid），始终1碳。1-丙醇到丙酸：CH₃CH₂CH₂OH + [O] → CH₃CH₂CHO + H₂O；CH₃CH₂CHO + [O] → CH₃CH₂COOH，依次propan-1-ol、propanal、propanoic acid，始终3碳。要由醛制丁酸，应选同为4碳的丁醛：CH₃CH₂CH₂CHO + [O] → CH₃CH₂CH₂COOH；不是先接长碳链。只讲净氧化与命名，不给实验操作；普通酮不直接套用醛到酸这一步。
text.en: Methanol: CH3OH + [O] → HCHO + H2O; HCHO + [O] → HCOOH. Methanol, methanal/formaldehyde and methanoic/formic acid retain one carbon. Propan-1-ol: CH3CH2CH2OH + [O] → CH3CH2CHO + H2O; CH3CH2CHO + [O] → CH3CH2COOH, retaining three carbons through propanal to propanoic acid. To form butanoic acid from an aldehyde, use four-carbon butanal: CH3CH2CH2CHO + [O] → CH3CH2CH2COOH. No chain extension or experimental procedure is implied; ordinary ketones do not follow this aldehyde step.

text.zh: methanoic acid＝formic acid＝甲酸；ethanoic acid＝acetic acid＝乙酸。书中的benzoic acid是苯甲酸，含苯环。多羧基酸的-dioic acid与-tricarboxylic acid有不同母体计数方式，不应把所有名称都机械套成单羧酸。
text.en: Methanoic/formic acid and ethanoic/acetic acid are systematic/common-name pairs. Benzoic acid contains a benzene ring. Dioic-acid and tricarboxylic-acid naming use different parent conventions.

title.en: An acid name does not prove a carboxyl group

text.zh: 书中列出的维生素C（ascorbic acid）没有游离COOH，不能因为名字有acid就当作羧酸。阿司匹林（ASA）则同时含羧基与酯基。官能团判断以真实连接为准，生活例子与必会命名规则分开。
text.en: Ascorbic acid has no free COOH group, despite its acid name. ASA contains both carboxyl and ester groups. Classify functional groups by their actual connectivity, not by everyday names.

text.zh: 本课普通酯的结构是R—C(=O)—O—R′，其中R也可以是H，R′从碳开始。羰基C与两个O属于酯基；桥氧另一边连接醇侧碳。酸侧碳链从羰基C数起，遇到单键O就停止，不能跨O接成一条烷烃母体。甲酸酯的酸侧只有羰基这1个碳。
text.en: An ordinary ester is R—C(=O)—O—R′, with R possibly H and R′ starting at carbon. The acid-side carbon chain includes the carbonyl carbon but stops at the single-bond O; it must not cross that oxygen. A methanoate has just one acid-side carbon.

title.zh: 英文先醇后酸，中文先酸后醇
title.en: English: alcohol side first; Chinese: acid side first

text.zh: 英文先写醇侧alkyl，再把酸名的-oic acid换成-oate；中文通常写“酸侧×酸＋醇侧×酯”。CH₃COOCH₃是methyl ethanoate＝乙酸甲酯；HCOOCH₂CH₃是ethyl methanoate＝甲酸乙酯。两者同为C₃H₆O₂，却是连接不同的结构异构体，不是把两个英文词调换一下。
text.en: Write the alcohol-derived alkyl first, then replace the acid ending -oic acid with -oate. Chinese names put the acid-derived part first. Methyl ethanoate, CH3COOCH3, and ethyl methanoate, HCOOCH2CH3, both have C3H6O2 but different connectivity.

title.zh: 酯化是可逆缩合，不是生成无机盐
title.en: Esterification is reversible condensation, not salt formation

concepts.reference: 教材p64–66及p68 Practice16的概念辨析

text.zh: 羧酸＋醇 ⇌ 酯＋水，通常用酸催化并加热。例如CH₃COOH＋CH₃OH ⇌ CH₃COOCH₃＋H₂O（H⁺、heat）。单羧酸与一元醇的净计量比为1∶1∶1∶1；达到平衡不等于全部转化。酸催化剂不是按1 mol消耗的反应物。普通酯是共价分子，不是羧酸根与金属阳离子组成的盐；不能照搬旧版“有机盐／中和”类比。
text.en: Carboxylic acid + alcohol ⇌ ester + water, usually with acid catalysis and heat. The net coefficients for a monocarboxylic acid and monohydric alcohol are 1:1:1:1, not a promise of complete conversion. The acid catalyst is not consumed stoichiometrically. An ordinary ester is covalent, not a carboxylate salt.

title.zh: 有极性、能接受氢键，不等于自带OH
title.en: Polar and H-bond accepting does not mean an OH donor

concepts.reference: 教材p66 Properties；对旧版绝对化表述作限定

text.zh: 酯基有极性，氧能接受来自水的氢键；但没有其他OH或NH的普通酯不能彼此提供OH型氢键。与相近大小的羧酸相比，沸点和水溶性常较低，烃部分变大通常更难溶；具体还受结构与温度影响，熔点尤其不能一概排序。小酯常是有可闻蒸气的液体，不是“低分子酯常温都为气体”。酯基也没有羧酸OH那样可解离的酸性H。
text.en: Esters are polar and their oxygens accept hydrogen bonds from water. Ordinary esters without another OH or NH group lack a hydrogen-bond donor. Boiling points and water solubility are often lower than for comparable acids, but structure and temperature matter, and melting points are not universal. Many small esters are volatile liquids, not room-temperature gases.

title.zh: 酸性水解：恢复酸与醇，有平衡箭头
title.en: Acid hydrolysis: acid + alcohol at equilibrium

concepts.reference: 教材p67 Hydrolysis / Practice14；原创酸碱对比

text.zh: 酯＋水 ⇌ 羧酸＋醇，采用酸催化并常需加热。例如HCOOCH₂CH₃＋H₂O ⇌ HCOOH＋CH₃CH₂OH（H⁺、heat），得到甲酸与乙醇。水参与反应，H⁺是催化剂；这是酯化的逆反应，不能把平衡箭头误读成必然完全水解。
text.en: Ester + water ⇌ carboxylic acid + alcohol under acid catalysis, often with heat. HCOOCH2CH3 + H2O ⇌ HCOOH + CH3CH2OH. Water is a reactant and H+ a catalyst; this is the reverse of esterification, not necessarily complete conversion.

title.zh: 碱性水解／皂化：直接产物是羧酸盐
title.en: Base hydrolysis / saponification gives a carboxylate

concepts.reference: 教材p67 / p68 q2(c)；纠正游离酸与盐的混用

text.zh: RCOOR′＋NaOH → RCOO⁻Na⁺＋R′OH。对一个普通酯基，净消耗1当量OH⁻；Na⁺为配对离子，羧酸根使逆向酯化受到抑制。例如CH₃COOCH₂CH₂CH₂CH₃＋NaOH → CH₃COO⁻Na⁺＋CH₃CH₂CH₂CH₂OH。这里直接得到乙酸钠与1-丁醇，不是游离乙酸；另行酸化才有CH₃COO⁻＋H⁺ → CH₃COOH。
text.en: RCOOR′ + NaOH → RCOO−Na+ + R′OH. One ester group consumes one equivalent of hydroxide; carboxylate formation suppresses the reverse esterification. Butyl ethanoate gives sodium ethanoate and butan-1-ol, not free ethanoic acid. A separate acidification converts CH3COO− + H+ → CH3COOH.

title.zh: 乙二醇两端都氧化，得到草酸
title.en: Oxidize both ends of ethane-1,2-diol to oxalic acid

concepts.reference: 教材p61–63 / Practice3、5；原创计量说明

text.zh: 伯醇可经醛氧化为酸，但不能说所有醇都走这条路。乙二醇HOCH₂CH₂OH的两端都是伯醇碳；两端充分氧化可得到HOOC—COOH，即ethanedioic acid／oxalic acid（草酸）。形式总式为HOCH₂CH₂OH＋4[O] → HOOC—COOH＋2H₂O。4[O]是净氧化当量，不是四个自由氧原子，也不是操作配方；两个碳从头到尾都保留。
text.en: Primary alcohols can oxidize through aldehydes to acids; this does not apply to every alcohol. Both ends of HOCH2CH2OH are primary-alcohol carbons. Formal complete oxidation gives HOCH2CH2OH + 4[O] → HOOC—COOH + 2H2O, retaining two carbons. [O] denotes oxidation equivalents, not free O atoms or an experimental recipe.

title.en: Dioic and tricarboxylic use different parent counts

concepts.reference: 教材p59多羧酸段落；原创计数对照

text.zh: HOOC—CH₂—COOH为propanedioic acid：两端羧基碳计入3碳母体。HOOC—COOH为ethanedioic acid：母体2碳。柠檬酸可写2-hydroxypropane-1,2,3-tricarboxylic acid：propane母体只有中间3碳，另接的3个carboxyl碳不计入propane，所以全分子共6碳。不能把这两种命名方式都套成“词根碳数＝分子总碳数”。
text.en: Propanedioic acid, HOOC—CH2—COOH, includes both carboxyl carbons in its three-carbon parent. Ethanedioic acid has two parent carbons. In 2-hydroxypropane-1,2,3-tricarboxylic acid, the propane parent excludes the three attached carboxyl carbons: three parent and six total carbons.

title.zh: 乳酸：alpha-hydroxy说明位置，不是完整名称
title.en: Lactic acid: alpha-hydroxy specifies a position

concepts.reference: 教材p58乳酸 / p63–64 Practice10；仅作结构背景

text.zh: 乳酸CH₃CH(OH)COOH的系统名是2-hydroxypropanoic acid。羧基C为1，邻碳为2，也叫alpha碳；额外OH在这个邻碳上，因此属于alpha-hydroxy carboxylic acids。这个OH与羧基自身的OH位置不同。“alpha hydroxy”只描述一类结构，不足以唯一指认一个化合物；此处不据此推导护肤功效，也不指定唯一立体构型。
text.en: Lactic acid, CH3CH(OH)COOH, is 2-hydroxypropanoic acid. Carbon2, adjacent to carboxyl carbon1, is the alpha carbon and carries the additional OH. Alpha-hydroxy describes a class, not a unique compound, cosmetic efficacy or a unique stereoisomer.

title.zh: 气味作背景，不作命名证据
title.en: Odour is context, not a naming rule

concepts.reference: 教材p64–65 Table2 / p66 Practice11；记录版内冲突

text.zh: 按本版Table2的背景标签，methyl butanoate对应苹果、ethyl benzoate对应樱桃、3-methylbutyl ethanoate对应香蕉、ethyl methanoate对应朗姆酒。它们只是特定气味联想，不代表真实水果只含一种酯。p65正文把ethyl butanoate说成香蕉味，而同页表格写菠萝味，存在冲突；课程不把该气味设成唯一答案，更不靠闻气味给结构命名。
text.en: Table2 associates methyl butanoate with apple, ethyl benzoate with cherry, 3-methylbutyl ethanoate with banana and ethyl methanoate with rum. These are contextual associations, not unique identities. Page65 prose calls ethyl butanoate banana-like while its table says pineapple; the course does not use that disputed odour as an assessed naming fact.

title.zh: 醇侧有支链，也从连O处核对
title.en: Check branches from the O-attached alcohol carbon

concepts.reference: 教材p66 Practice11(d) / p68 q1(b)、q3(a)、q4(b)；文字拓展

text.zh: 3-methylbutyl为O—CH₂—CH₂—CH(CH₃)—CH₃；连O的碳是醇侧编号1，所以甲基在3位，不是2位。p68 q1(b)原图则为CH₃CH₂C(=O)OCH₂CH(CH₃)CH₂CH₂CH₃，甲基实际在醇侧2位，应为2-methylpentyl propanoate；另设明确标为变式的3-methylpentyl题，不冒称原题。2-丁醇生成酯时O仍接CH而非CH₂，酯名用butan-2-yl methanoate（甲酸仲丁酯）。
text.en: The 3-methylbutyl group is O—CH2—CH2—CH(CH3)—CH3, numbered from its O-attached carbon. The actual page68 q1(b) diagram is OCH2CH(CH3)CH2CH2CH3 on the alcohol side, hence 2-methylpentyl propanoate; a separate 3-methylpentyl variant is labelled as such. Butan-2-ol gives O—CH connectivity and the name butan-2-yl methanoate.

title.en: Phenyl and benzoate place the ring on opposite sides

concepts.reference: 教材p65–66 Sample1 / p68 q2(e)；非普通醇的条件限定

text.zh: C₆H₅C(=O)OCH₃为methyl benzoate，苯环在酸侧；CH₃C(=O)OC₆H₅为phenyl ethanoate（乙酸苯酯），苯环在O的另一侧。p68 q2(e)预期后者。CH₃COOH＋C₆H₅OH ⇌ CH₃COOC₆H₅＋H₂O在这里仅作形式组成式：苯酚不能直接照搬普通醇的酸催化酯化制法。真实制备通常要活化酰基，例如(CH₃CO)₂O＋C₆H₅OH → CH₃COOC₆H₅＋CH₃COOH；这里只辨析反应，不提供实验步骤。
text.en: Methyl benzoate, C6H5C(=O)OCH3, has its ring on the acid side; phenyl ethanoate, CH3C(=O)OC6H5, has it beyond O. The latter is the intended page68 q2(e) product. Acid + phenol → ester + water is only a formal composition relationship here: ordinary alcohol Fischer conditions cannot simply be assumed for phenol. An activated acyl reagent, such as ethanoic anhydride, provides a realistic alternative equation, not a laboratory procedure.

title.zh: 一个酯键到多个酯键：油脂与聚酯
title.en: From one ester link to fats and polyesters

concepts.reference: 教材p67油脂、皂化与聚酯背景；原创简述

text.zh: 油脂主要是甘油与脂肪酸形成的三酯；完全碱性水解每个酯键净消耗1个OH⁻，一个三酯共需3个。长链脂肪酸的钠盐或钾盐可作肥皂，但甲酸钠、乙酸钠不能因此都叫肥皂。双官能团单体可反复形成酯键连接为聚酯；“酯”说的是局部连接，“聚酯”说的是带重复酯键的长链。
text.en: Fats and oils are mainly glycerol triesters. Complete base hydrolysis consumes one hydroxide per ester linkage, three per triester. Long-chain fatty-acid salts can act as soaps; not every carboxylate salt is soap. Bifunctional monomers can form repeated ester links in a polyester chain.

question.en: How do I recognize a carboxylic acid?

answer.zh: 记“同碳双氧，一双一单，单氧带H”：同一个C连C=O和C—OH。不能把分子中任意一处C=O和远处OH拼成羧基。
answer.en: On the same carbon: one double-bond oxygen and one single-bond OH. A carbonyl and a distant OH do not make a carboxyl group.

question.en: What order should I use for acid naming?

answer.zh: 找酸基 → 含酸碳的最长链 → 酸碳定1号 → 找不饱和与支链 → 合成名称。先选链，后编号；不是先看图的左右。
answer.en: Find COOH → longest parent containing its carbon → carboxyl carbon is1 → locate unsaturation and branches → assemble the name.

question.zh: -oic acid和母体碳数有什么关系？
question.en: How does -oic acid relate to the parent?

answer.zh: 对应烷烃词根保留相同母体碳数，去掉末尾e，接-oic acid。meth/eth/prop/but/pent/hex/hept/oct依次为1–8碳；COOH里的C不能再额外添加。
answer.en: Keep the parent carbon count, remove the alkane ending e and add -oic acid. Meth through oct indicate1 through8 parent carbons, including the carboxyl carbon.

question.zh: 支链会增加母体词根吗？
question.en: Does every branch increase the parent root?

answer.zh: 不一定。2-methylbutanoic acid的butan母体为4碳，methyl另加1碳，总数5碳。主链长度由选链规则决定，不由分子总碳数决定。
answer.en: Not automatically: 2-methylbutanoic acid has a four-carbon butanoic parent plus a one-carbon methyl branch, five carbons in total.

question.zh: 根据名字画结构的顺序？
question.en: How do I draw a structure from its name?

answer.zh: 拆词 → 画母体 → 放官能团和不饱和 → 加支链 → 按价态补H或写CH₃/CH₂ → 核对。书面简写与展开式都可以，但应按题目指定格式，不能在同一步自动冒出氧和双键两根线。
answer.en: Decode → draw the parent → add the functional group and unsaturation → add branches → complete H or condensed labels → check. Match the required written format; draw O before each double-bond line.

question.en: Why does the carboxyl carbon usually have no H?

answer.zh: 羧基碳的C=O占2，C—OH占1，再连碳占1，四价已满。甲酸例外：它没有另一个碳，剩下的一价连H。记价态，不要死记“所有酸碳没有H”。
answer.en: C=O uses2, C–OH uses1 and C–C uses1 bond order. In methanoic acid there is no C–C bond, so the remaining valence attaches H.

question.zh: 怎样认酯基，又怎样把两侧分开？
question.en: How do I recognize an ester and split its two sides?

answer.zh: 找C(=O)—O—C，不是只找两个O。从羰基C沿碳链数酸侧，遇单键O停止；O后面的碳组是醇侧。COO中两个O之间没有O—O键。
answer.en: Find C(=O)—O—C. Count the acid side from its carbonyl carbon and stop at the single-bond O; the carbon group beyond O is the alcohol side. COO does not contain an O—O bond.

question.zh: 酯的中英文次序怎么记？
question.en: How do the English and Chinese orders differ?

answer.zh: 英文“醇侧alkyl＋酸侧oate”，中文“酸侧×酸＋醇侧×酯”。methyl ethanoate＝乙酸甲酯；ethyl methanoate＝甲酸乙酯。要换结构，不是只交换名字。
answer.en: English puts alkyl before acid-derived oate; Chinese puts the acid-derived part first. Methyl ethanoate is CH3COOCH3; ethyl methanoate is HCOOCH2CH3. Swapping the two parts changes connectivity.

question.zh: 看到酯，怎样反推原料酸和醇？
question.en: How do I recover the acid and alcohol on paper?

answer.zh: 把R—C(=O)—O—R′在C(=O)—O处概念拆开：酸侧补OH成为RCOOH，O—R′补H成为R′OH。例如CH₃CH₂COOCH₂CH₃对应丙酸与乙醇；这是组成核对，不是徒手断键步骤。
answer.en: Conceptually split R—C(=O)—O—R′ at the acyl–O bond: complete RCOOH and R′OH. CH3CH2COOCH2CH3 corresponds to propanoic acid and ethanol. This is a structural check, not a physical cutting step.

question.zh: 酯化条件、箭头和当量如何一起记？
question.en: What conditions, arrow and coefficients belong to esterification?

answer.zh: 羧酸＋醇 ⇌ 酯＋水，H⁺催化、heat；一个COOH与一个OH净配成1个酯基和1个H₂O。1∶1当量不等于100%收率，催化H⁺也不按1∶1消耗。
answer.en: Acid + alcohol ⇌ ester + water, with H+ catalysis and heat. One COOH plus one alcohol OH gives one ester linkage and one H2O. Stoichiometric 1:1 does not mean 100% yield or one equivalent of consumed catalyst.

question.zh: 酸性与碱性水解，最关键差别是什么？
question.en: What is the key difference between acid and base hydrolysis?

answer.zh: 酸性：ester＋H₂O ⇌ acid＋alcohol，H⁺为催化剂。碱性：ester＋NaOH → carboxylate Na＋alcohol，OH⁻净消耗。皂化直接给盐，另行酸化才得到游离酸。
answer.en: Acid: ester + H2O ⇌ acid + alcohol, catalysed by H+. Base: ester + NaOH → sodium carboxylate + alcohol, consuming hydroxide. Free acid requires a separate acidification after saponification.

question.zh: 酯有氧，为什么不等同醇的氢键性质？
question.en: Why do ester oxygens not give alcohol-like H-bond donation?

answer.zh: 普通酯的O能接受水的氢键，但酯基本身没有OH供体。它仍有极性；小酯不全是气体，也不全与水任意互溶。比较性质要看大小、结构和条件。
answer.en: Ester O atoms accept H bonds from water, but the ester group has no OH donor. Esters remain polar; small ones are not all gases or completely water-miscible. Compare size, structure and conditions.

question.zh: 酯是旧版说的“有机盐”吗？
question.en: Is an ester really an organic salt?

answer.zh: 不是通常意义的盐。CH₃COOCH₃是共价分子；CH₃COO⁻Na⁺才是羧酸盐。名称都像两部分，不代表键型和反应类型相同。
answer.en: Not in the usual ionic sense: CH3COOCH3 is a covalent molecule, whereas CH3COO−Na+ is a carboxylate salt. Two-part names do not imply the same bonding or reaction type.

answer.zh: 从连O的CH₂开始1，下一CH₂为2，CH为3并连CH₃支链，末端CH₃为4：O—CH₂—CH₂—CH(CH₃)—CH₃。酸侧也有自己的编号，两侧不能串号。
answer.en: O—CH2(1)—CH2(2)—CH(3)(CH3)—CH3(4). The alcohol-side locants are separate from acid-side numbering; do not number straight across the bridging oxygen.

question.en: How do I distinguish benzoate from phenyl esters?

answer.zh: benzoate看C₆H₅—C(=O)—O，苯环直接接羰基C；phenyl ethanoate看CH₃—C(=O)—O—C₆H₅，苯环接桥氧。先看真实连接，不把phenyl误叫benzyl。
answer.en: Benzoate has C6H5—C(=O)—O; phenyl ethanoate has CH3—C(=O)—O—C6H5. Phenyl attaches directly at a ring carbon; benzyl would add CH2.

question.en: How does ethane-1,2-diol correspond to oxalic acid?

answer.zh: HOCH₂CH₂OH两端都是伯醇，充分氧化为HOOC—COOH；总式加4[O]、生成2H₂O。两个碳都保留，草酸即ethanedioic acid；[O]只表示氧化当量。
answer.en: Both primary-alcohol ends of HOCH2CH2OH oxidize to HOOC—COOH. The formal net equation uses 4[O] and forms 2H2O, retaining both carbons. Oxalic acid is ethanedioic acid.

question.zh: 多羧酸的词根能当总碳数吗？
question.en: Does a polycarboxylic parent root always give total carbons?

answer.zh: 不能一概而论。propanedioic acid把两端酸碳算进3；柠檬酸的propane-1,2,3-tricarboxylic acid框架是3个母体碳另加3个酸碳，总6。
answer.en: Not always. Propanedioic acid includes both terminal carboxyl carbons in its three-carbon parent. A propane-1,2,3-tricarboxylic framework has three parent plus three carboxyl carbons, six total.

question.en: Where is the extra OH in lactic acid?

answer.zh: CH₃CH(OH)COOH：羧基碳1号，额外OH在邻碳2号，故2-hydroxypropanoic acid。alpha就是邻羧基碳，不是羧基自己的OH。
answer.en: CH3CH(OH)COOH: carboxyl carbon is1 and the extra OH is on adjacent carbon2, giving 2-hydroxypropanoic acid. Alpha refers to that adjacent carbon.

topic.zh: 丙烯酸：展开式与两个双键
topic.en: Unsaturated acid: displayed structure

lessons.reference: 教材p60 sample：propenoic acid；原创逐笔讲解

breakdown.zh: prop＝3个母体碳；en＝有C=C；oic acid＝羧酸。酸碳是1号，另一个双键只能在2/3号之间。
breakdown.en: Prop gives3 parent carbons, en a C=C bond, and oic acid a carboxylic acid. Carboxyl carbon is1; the alkene bond is between2 and3.

review.zh: 3个碳中已经包含羧基碳；C=C在2/3位，C=O朝上，右侧为OH。C₃H₄O₂；羧基碳不带H。
review.en: Three carbons include the carboxyl carbon. C=C is at2/3, C=O is above and OH at the right. Formula C3H4O2; no H on the carboxyl carbon.

text.zh: 右端同一C连上方O双键和右侧OH，因此是羧酸，不是醛或酮。
text.en: The right-end carbon joins double O above and OH on its right: a carboxylic acid.

text.zh: 沿C—C—C只有3个碳；不能在三碳链旁另加一个COOH碳。
text.en: There are3 connected parent carbons, including the carboxyl carbon; do not add a fourth.

text.zh: 从右往左编1、2、3；C=C连接2号和3号。把三碳词根prop、不饱和en及羧酸后缀连起来，下一步核对完整名称。
text.en: Number1,2,3 from the acid end. C=C joins2/3. Combine the three-carbon root prop, unsaturation en and the acid suffix; check the complete name in the next step.

text.zh: 3碳＋烯＋羧酸＝丙烯酸。课本写propenoic acid，现代带定位号写prop-2-enoic acid。用结构区分主链C=C和羧基C=O两个双键。
text.en: Three-carbon unsaturated acid: propenoic acid in the textbook, also written prop-2-enoic acid with its locant. Distinguish the chain C=C from the carboxyl C=O.

topic.zh: 支链酸：主链会转弯
topic.en: Branched acid: the parent can bend

lessons.reference: 教材p60 example / Practice1(c)；保留课本弯折简写布局

breakdown.zh: butanoic acid＝含酸碳的4碳母体；2-methyl＝2号碳连接CH₃。总碳数为4＋1＝5，不是戊酸。
breakdown.en: Butanoic acid gives4 parent carbons including COOH; 2-methyl places CH3 at parent carbon2. Total carbon count5 does not make a pentanoic parent.

review.zh: 书中主链从COOH向左经过CH、CH₂，再向下到左下CH₃，共4碳；右下CH₃是2号支链。总式C₅H₁₀O₂。
review.en: Follow COOH left through CH and CH2, then down to the left CH3:4 parent carbons. The other downward CH3 is the2-methyl branch. Formula C5H10O2.

text.zh: COOH缩写中藏着羧基C和两个O，但只有一个C，不可省掉也不能数两次。
text.en: COOH contains one carbon and two oxygens. Count its carbon once.

text.zh: 从酸碳走到CH、CH₂，再走到左下CH₃，是包含酸碳的最长4碳链。只数横排会误以为3碳。
text.en: The longest chain goes from acid carbon through CH and CH2 to the left lower CH3. It has4 carbons, not just the3 labels across the top.

text.zh: 从COOH编1、2、3、4；连在CH上的右下CH₃不是主链，是2号甲基。
text.en: Number from COOH as1,2,3,4. The downward CH3 on CH is a methyl branch at2.

text.zh: 得到2-methylbutanoic acid。总碳5、母体4；两个数字都要能解释。
text.en: The name is2-methylbutanoic acid. Explain both the4-carbon parent and5-carbon total.

topic.zh: 一碳酸：甲酸的H例外
topic.en: One-carbon acid: the H exception

lessons.reference: 教材p59 / p60 Practice2(a)

breakdown.zh: meth＝1碳。唯一的C就是羧基C，左边接H而不是CH₃。
breakdown.en: Meth gives1 carbon, the carboxyl carbon itself. H, not CH3, attaches to its other side.

review.zh: C=O双键占2价，C—OH占1，C—H占1；酸中共有2个H，一个在C上、一个在O上。
review.en: C=O uses2, C–OH1 and C–H1 valence. The two H atoms are attached to carbon and oxygen respectively.

text.zh: 左端H不能让它成为醛，因为右端还接OH，是羧酸。
text.en: The left H does not make this an aldehyde: OH also attaches to the carbonyl carbon, making a carboxylic acid.

text.zh: H不是碳；整个分子只有羧基中的一个C，词根meth。
text.en: H is not carbon. Only the carboxyl carbon is present, so the root is meth.

text.zh: methanoic acid＝formic acid，中文甲酸；无需额外写位置1。
text.en: Methanoic acid is also called formic acid; no extra locant1 is required.

topic.zh: 两碳酸与乙醇氧化
topic.en: Two-carbon acid and ethanol oxidation

lessons.reference: 教材p58–59 / p61乙醇氧化

breakdown.zh: eth＝2碳，其中一个就是酸碳。左侧写CH₃，右侧画C(=O)OH。
breakdown.en: Eth gives2 carbons, one already in the carboxyl group. Write CH3 on the left and C(=O)OH on the right.

review.zh: CH₃COOH总共2个碳、4个氢、2个氧。它与乙醇的碳链相同，但不是同一个官能团。
review.en: CH3COOH contains2 C,4 H and2 O. Its carbon chain is the same length as ethanol, but its functional group differs.

text.zh: 上方O双键、右侧OH单键都接同一C。
text.en: The double-bond O above and single-bond OH on the right attach to the same carbon.

text.zh: 从羧基C到CH₃只有两个C，母体词根eth。
text.en: The carboxyl carbon plus the CH3 carbon make an eth parent.

text.zh: ethanoic acid，俗名acetic acid。酸碳编号1但名称不另写1。
text.en: Ethanoic acid, commonly acetic acid. Carboxyl carbon is1 without writing a redundant1 in the name.

topic.zh: 长直链酸：酸碳包含在8碳里
topic.en: Straight-chain acid: eight includes COOH carbon

lessons.reference: 教材p60 Practice1(a)；原创示范答案

breakdown.zh: oct＝8个母体碳；酸碳占1，剩下7个C为六个CH₂加一个CH₃。不能画8个烷基C再加COOH。
breakdown.en: Oct gives8 parent carbons. After the acid carbon, use six CH2 groups and one CH3, not8 alkyl carbons plus COOH.

review.zh: 数C：1个COOH碳＋6个CH₂碳＋1个CH₃碳＝8。数H：1＋12＋3＝16，总式C₈H₁₆O₂。
review.en: C:1 carboxyl+6 methylene+1 methyl=8. H:1+12+3=16. Formula C8H16O2.

text.zh: 右端C=O与OH为酸基，不将两个氧算成两个碳。
text.en: The right-end C=O and OH form the acid group; the two oxygens are not extra carbons.

text.zh: 从酸碳向左数满8个C，词根oct，无支链。
text.en: Count8 connected C from the acid end: oct, without branches.

text.zh: 饱和8碳母体命名为octanoic acid，中文辛酸。
text.en: The saturated eight-carbon parent gives octanoic acid.

topic.zh: 芳香酸：保留六边形苯环
topic.en: Aromatic acid: keep the benzene hexagon

lessons.reference: 教材p59 / p60 Practice1(b)；芳环与羧基的书面表示

breakdown.zh: benzoic acid指苯环直接接COOH。苯环6碳，加羧基1碳，总7碳；不是把苯环拆成直链庚酸。
breakdown.en: Benzoic acid has COOH directly on a benzene ring. Six ring carbons plus one acid carbon give7 total; do not redraw it as heptanoic acid.

review.zh: 六边形顶点代表6个C，内圆圈表示苯环离域芳香性，不是额外原子或一条额外键。右上顶点斜接展开羧基C(=O)—OH，酸碳另计1个，总式C₇H₆O₂。
review.en: Six hexagon vertices represent6 carbons. The inner circle denotes aromatic delocalization, not an extra atom or bond. The upper-right vertex joins the displayed C(=O)—OH group diagonally, adding one acid carbon; formula C7H6O2.

text.zh: 先识别COOH，再看它直接连着苯环而不是烷烃直链。
text.en: Identify COOH and its direct connection to a benzene ring, not an open alkane chain.

text.zh: 环内6碳和酸碳1个分开计数；六边形顶点即碳，不必每个都写C。
text.en: Count6 ring carbons and1 acid carbon separately. Unlabelled hexagon vertices represent carbon.

text.zh: 中文苯甲酸；教材也给phenylmethanoic acid作为等价名称。本页主显示课本常用的benzoic acid。
text.en: Use benzoic acid as the textbook's familiar name; phenylmethanoic acid is another name mentioned there.

topic.zh: 练习2(b)：乙基不算进五碳母体
topic.en: Practice2(b): ethyl versus five-carbon parent

lessons.reference: 教材p60 Practice2(b)；按用户照片重建结构

breakdown.zh: pentanoic acid＝5碳酸母体；3-ethyl＝3号处另接2碳乙基。该图有两个等长末端，选定主链后另一条为乙基。
breakdown.en: Pentanoic acid gives5 parent carbons; 3-ethyl adds a two-carbon branch at3. Equivalent longest paths occur; the remaining two-carbon arm is ethyl.

review.zh: 从右酸碳编1，CH₂为2，中间CH为3，左侧CH₂/CH₃为4/5；下方CH₂CH₃在3位。总碳7、母体5。
review.en: From the acid end:1, CH2 at2, CH at3, left CH2/CH3 at4/5. The lower CH2CH3 is at3. Total7, parent5.

title.en: Begin at the right-hand acid carbon

text.zh: 右端C(=O)OH定为1号，不能从左端CH₃开始编号。
text.en: The right C(=O)OH carbon is1; do not begin numbering at the left CH3.

title.zh: 选包含酸碳的最长五碳链

text.zh: 从COOH经CH₂、CH再经一条两碳末端，共5碳。另一个两碳末端成为乙基。
text.en: COOH through CH2 and CH, then either two-carbon arm, forms a5-carbon parent. The other arm is ethyl.

text.zh: 图中向下CH₂CH₃是两个C，连接点为中间CH，即母体3号。
text.en: The downward CH2CH3 has two carbons and attaches at the middle CH, parent position3.

text.zh: 3-ethylpentanoic acid＝3-乙基戊酸；总7碳不等于heptanoic acid。
text.en: 3-Ethylpentanoic acid; the7-carbon total does not mean a heptanoic parent.

topic.zh: 练习2(c)：两个乙基与六碳主链
topic.en: Practice2(c): two ethyl groups and a six-carbon parent

lessons.reference: 教材p60 Practice2(c)；保持上/下乙基表示

breakdown.zh: hexanoic＝含酸碳的6碳母体；diethyl＝两个各2碳乙基；2,3为从酸端开始的支链位置。总碳6＋2＋2＝10。
breakdown.en: Hexanoic gives6 parent carbons including the acid carbon; diethyl adds two two-carbon groups at2 and3. Total carbon count is10.

review.zh: 横排主链六碳，酸端为1；2号下方CH₂CH₃与3号上方CH₃CH₂都是乙基，连接都从CH₂端。C₁₀H₂₀O₂。
review.en: Six-carbon horizontal parent, numbered from the acid end. The lower group at2 and upper group at3 are ethyl, both attached through CH2. Formula C10H20O2.

title.en: Find the acid carbon at the right

text.zh: 羧基C=O与OH在右端；以这个C为1号。
text.en: C=O and OH share the right-end carbon, assigned1.

title.zh: 选六碳链，不是所有碳都算母体
title.en: Choose six parent carbons, not all carbons

text.zh: 从右经两个CH，再经两个CH₂到左端CH₃，最长含酸链6碳。其余4碳属于两个支链。
text.en: From the acid carbon through two CH and two CH2 to terminal CH3 gives6 parent carbons. The remaining4 belong to two branches.

text.zh: 下方支链接2号，上方支链接3号。CH₃CH₂书写方向不同，但连接锚点都是CH₂。
text.en: The lower branch is at2, the upper at3. Reversed condensed text CH3CH2 still attaches through CH2.

title.en: Use diethyl for two identical branches

text.zh: 名称2,3-diethylhexanoic acid。数字之间逗号，数字与词之间连字符；不能把两个ethyl漏成一个。
text.en: 2,3-Diethylhexanoic acid. Use a comma between locants and a hyphen before the branch word; retain both ethyl groups.

topic.zh: p66例题：乙酸甲酯，两侧不要读反
topic.en: Page66 Example: methyl ethanoate

lessons.reference: 教材印刷p66 Example；原创展开酯基与中英讲解

breakdown.zh: methyl来自醇侧O—CH₃；ethanoate来自酸侧CH₃—C(=O)，共2碳含羰基碳。英文先醇后酸，中文乙酸＋甲酯。
breakdown.en: Methyl comes from O—CH3; ethanoate comes from the two-carbon CH3—C(=O) acid side, including the carbonyl carbon. The English and Chinese component orders differ.

review.zh: CH₃COOH＋CH₃OH ⇌ CH₃COOCH₃＋H₂O（H⁺催化、heat）。乙酸＋甲醇 ⇌ 乙酸甲酯＋水。全分子3碳，酸侧母体2碳；不是甲酸乙酯。
review.en: Ethanoic acid + methanol ⇌ methyl ethanoate + water, with H+ catalysis and heat. Three total carbons, two acid-parent carbons; this is not ethyl methanoate.

text.zh: 同一C连上方O双键和右侧桥氧，桥氧再连CH₃：这是酯而非羧酸。
text.en: The carbonyl carbon joins O above and a bridging O on the right; that O joins CH3. This is an ester, not a carboxylic acid.

text.zh: 从羰基C编号1到左边CH₃为2；单键O阻断碳链，酸侧为ethanoate。
text.en: Number carbonyl C as1 and the left CH3 as2. Stop at O: the acid-derived part is ethanoate.

text.zh: O后只有一个CH₃，对应甲醇methanol；不能把左侧CH₃认作醇侧。
text.en: The O-attached CH3 corresponds to methanol. Do not mistake the left acid-side CH3 for the alcohol side.

text.zh: 英文methyl＋ethanoate；中文乙酸＋甲酯。核对式CH₃COOCH₃与C₃H₆O₂；与HCOOCH₂CH₃连接不同。
text.en: Combine methyl + ethanoate. Check CH3COOCH3 and C3H6O2; HCOOCH2CH3 has different connectivity.

topic.zh: p65–66样题2：从丁酸乙酯反推原料
topic.en: Pages65–66 Sample2: recover the reactants

lessons.reference: 教材印刷p65反应示例 / p66 Sample problem2；气味冲突不作命名依据

breakdown.zh: butanoate的酸侧含羰基C共4碳；ethyl为O后两碳CH₂CH₃。全分子4＋2＝6碳，不是把6碳跨O叫hexanoate。
breakdown.en: Butanoate contains four acid-side carbons including C=O; ethyl is the two-carbon group beyond O. Total6 does not make a hexanoate parent across oxygen.

review.zh: CH₃CH₂CH₂COOH＋CH₃CH₂OH ⇌ CH₃CH₂CH₂COOCH₂CH₃＋H₂O（H⁺、heat）。丁酸＋乙醇 ⇌ 丁酸乙酯＋水。结构定名不依赖书中互相冲突的气味标签。
review.en: Butanoic acid + ethanol ⇌ ethyl butanoate + water, with H+ and heat. Name by connectivity, not the conflicting odour labels in this edition.

text.zh: C=O朝上，C—O—CH₂横向连接；桥氧上没有酸的H。
text.en: C=O points upward and C—O—CH2 runs horizontally. The bridge oxygen has no acidic OH hydrogen.

title.en: Count four carbons on the acid side

text.zh: 羰基C为1，左边CH₂、CH₂、CH₃为2、3、4，对应butanoic acid，再换成butanoate。
text.en: Carbonyl C is1; CH2, CH2 and CH3 are2,3,4. Butanoic acid becomes butanoate.

title.en: Two carbons beyond O come from ethanol

text.zh: O—CH₂—CH₃为ethyl；复原醇时写HOCH₂CH₃。
text.en: O—CH2—CH3 supplies ethyl; the corresponding alcohol is HOCH2CH3.

title.zh: 英文ethyl butanoate，中文丁酸乙酯

text.zh: 乙醇给ethyl，丁酸给butanoate；1份酸与1份醇的净酯化生成1份酯和1份水，但反应可逆。
text.en: Ethanol supplies ethyl and butanoic acid supplies butanoate. The net1:1 esterification forms ester and water at equilibrium.

topic.zh: p65–66样题1：苯环保留为圆圈六边形
topic.en: Pages65–66 Sample1: preserve the benzene ring

lessons.reference: 教材印刷p65–66 Sample problem1；原创芳环与展开酯基重绘

breakdown.zh: 苯环直接连C(=O)O，酸侧为benzoate；O后CH₂CH₂CH₃来自1-丙醇，为propyl。环6碳与羰基1碳都在酸侧，但苯环母体仍是6个环碳。
breakdown.en: The ring attaches directly to C(=O)O, giving benzoate. O—CH2CH2CH3 comes from propan-1-ol and gives propyl. The six-carbon ring parent is distinct from the extra acid carbonyl carbon.

review.zh: C₆H₅COOH＋HOCH₂CH₂CH₃ ⇌ C₆H₅COOCH₂CH₂CH₃＋H₂O（H⁺、heat）。苯甲酸＋1-丙醇 ⇌ 苯甲酸丙酯＋水；总碳6＋1＋3＝10。环内圆圈表示芳香性，不是额外原子。
review.en: Benzoic acid + propan-1-ol ⇌ propyl benzoate + water, with H+ and heat. Total carbons:6 ring+1 carbonyl+3 propyl=10. The inner circle represents aromaticity, not another atom.

title.en: The ring joins the carbonyl, not the bridging O

text.zh: 沿六边形右顶点到C，再到O—丙基；这决定酸侧是苯甲酸衍生部分。
text.en: Follow the right ring vertex to carbonyl C, then O—propyl. The ring is on the acid-derived side.

text.zh: 六边形顶点各代表一个碳；不能拉直叫heptanoate，也不能把羰基C塞进苯环。
text.en: Each hexagon vertex represents carbon. Do not flatten the ring into heptanoate or insert the carbonyl carbon into it.

title.en: Three straight-chain carbons beyond O: propyl

text.zh: 桥氧连CH₂再到CH₂、CH₃，复原为1-丙醇，不是O连中间CH的异丙醇。
text.en: O joins CH2, then CH2 and CH3: propan-1-ol, not the O-attached central CH of propan-2-ol.

text.zh: 英文先propyl后benzoate；中文先苯甲酸后丙酯。用苯甲酸与1-丙醇的可逆酯化核对。
text.en: Write propyl before benzoate and check against reversible esterification of benzoic acid with propan-1-ol.

topic.zh: p66练习11(a)：甲酸的H不能画成CH₃
topic.en: Page66 Practice11(a): retain the methanoate H

lessons.reference: 教材印刷p66 Practice11(a) / p67 Practice14；原创结构与水解对照

breakdown.zh: methanoate的酸侧只有羰基这1碳，另一价连H；ethyl为O后CH₂CH₃两碳。左侧H不是碳，不能误数成乙酸酯。
breakdown.en: Methanoate has only its carbonyl carbon on the acid side, with H on the remaining valence. Ethyl is O—CH2CH3. The left H is not another carbon.

review.zh: HCOOH＋CH₃CH₂OH ⇌ HCOOCH₂CH₃＋H₂O（H⁺、heat）。甲酸＋乙醇 ⇌ 甲酸乙酯＋水；酸性水解逆向得到甲酸和乙醇，碱性水解则直接给甲酸钠和乙醇。
review.en: Methanoic acid + ethanol ⇌ ethyl methanoate + water, with H+ and heat. Acid hydrolysis returns the acid and alcohol; NaOH hydrolysis gives sodium methanoate and ethanol.

title.zh: 先找酯基，别被左端H迷惑
title.en: Recognize the ester despite the left H

text.zh: 羰基C另连O—CH₂CH₃，因此是酯；有C—H不代表它就是醛。
text.en: Carbonyl C also joins O—CH2CH3, making an ester. A C—H bond alone does not make it an aldehyde.

text.zh: 左端只有H，唯一酸侧碳就是C=O的C；对应甲酸HCOOH。
text.en: Only H lies to the left: the carbonyl carbon is the sole acid-side C, corresponding to HCOOH.

text.zh: 桥氧右连CH₂—CH₃，对应乙醇，不是甲醇。
text.en: O joins CH2—CH3, corresponding to ethanol rather than methanol.

topic.zh: p66练习11(b)：芳香酸与乙醇酯化
topic.en: Page66 Practice11(b): benzoic acid and ethanol

lessons.reference: 教材印刷p66 Practice11(b)；原创圆圈芳环重绘与反应式

breakdown.zh: ethyl为O后两碳；benzoate为苯环直接接C(=O)O的酸侧。乙基不是乙酸，苯甲酸侧也不是苯酚侧。
breakdown.en: Ethyl is the two-carbon group beyond O; benzoate is the ring directly attached to C(=O)O. Ethyl does not mean ethanoic acid, and benzoate is not phenol-derived.

review.zh: C₆H₅COOH＋CH₃CH₂OH ⇌ C₆H₅COOCH₂CH₃＋H₂O（H⁺、heat）。苯甲酸＋乙醇 ⇌ 苯甲酸乙酯＋水。总碳6＋1＋2＝9，式C₉H₁₀O₂。
review.en: Benzoic acid + ethanol ⇌ ethyl benzoate + water, with H+ and heat. Six ring carbons plus one carbonyl plus two ethyl carbons give C9H10O2.

text.zh: 环右顶点先连羰基C，再连桥氧；桥氧另一边才是乙基。
text.en: The right ring vertex joins carbonyl C, then bridging O; the ethyl group is beyond that O.

text.zh: 苯甲酸失去羧基OH上的H后，与醇侧形成共价酯；这里不是苯甲酸根金属盐。
text.en: The benzoic-acid-derived part forms a covalent ester with the alcohol side, not a metal benzoate salt.

text.zh: 两碳醇侧复原为乙醇HOCH₂CH₃；不能把环6碳计入ethyl。
text.en: The two-carbon alcohol side corresponds to ethanol, HOCH2CH3; ring carbons are not part of ethyl.

text.zh: 先乙醇侧ethyl，后苯甲酸侧benzoate；中文顺序相反。反应物为苯甲酸和乙醇。
text.en: Write ethanol-derived ethyl before acid-derived benzoate; the reactants are benzoic acid and ethanol.

topic.zh: p66练习11(c)／12(b)：同一结构只讲一次
topic.en: Page66 Practice11(c) /12(b): one shared structure

lessons.reference: 教材印刷p65反应式 / p66 Practice11(c)、12(b)；合并重复结构

breakdown.zh: methyl是桥氧后1碳，butanoate是含羰基碳的4碳酸侧。命名和反推原料是同一连接的两种读法。
breakdown.en: Methyl is the one-carbon group beyond O; butanoate is the four-carbon acid side including the carbonyl. Naming and recovering reactants read the same connectivity.

review.zh: CH₃CH₂CH₂COOH＋CH₃OH ⇌ CH₃CH₂CH₂COOCH₃＋H₂O（H⁺、heat）。丁酸＋甲醇 ⇌ 丁酸甲酯＋水；总碳4＋1＝5，不能据总碳改叫pentanoate。
review.en: Butanoic acid + methanol ⇌ methyl butanoate + water, with H+ and heat. Four acid-side plus one alcohol-side carbon give5 total, not a pentanoate parent.

title.en: Both ester oxygens attach to carbonyl C

text.zh: 上方O为双键，右边O为单键桥；COO简写不代表O—O相连。
text.en: The O above is double bonded; the right O is the single-bond bridge. COO is not an O—O linkage.

title.en: Four carbons including the carbonyl on the left

text.zh: 按1羰基C、2CH₂、3CH₂、4CH₃数出butanoate。
text.en: Count carbonyl C1, CH2 at2, CH2 at3 and CH3 at4: butanoate.

text.zh: 桥氧后1碳给methyl，补回H后为CH₃OH。
text.en: One carbon beyond O gives methyl; restoring H on O gives CH3OH.

text.zh: Practice11(c)从名称写反应，12(b)从式认名与原料；两问都用丁酸＋甲醇。
text.en: Practice11(c) starts from the name and12(b) from the formula; both correspond to butanoic acid plus methanol.

topic.zh: p66练习11(d)：异戊基从O端数到3位
topic.en: Page66 Practice11(d): number isoamyl from O

lessons.reference: 教材印刷p64 Table2 / p66 Practice11(d)；真实醇侧为CH₂CH₂CH(CH₃)CH₃

breakdown.zh: ethanoate是CH₃—C(=O)酸侧2碳；3-methylbutyl是O—CH₂—CH₂—CH(CH₃)—CH₃，醇侧4碳主链加3位甲基，共5碳。3这个位置号只属于醇侧。
breakdown.en: Ethanoate is the two-carbon acid side. The alcohol group is O—CH2—CH2—CH(CH3)—CH3: a four-carbon chain with a methyl at3, five alcohol-side carbons total. Locant3 belongs to the alcohol side.

review.zh: CH₃COOH＋HOCH₂CH₂CH(CH₃)CH₃ ⇌ CH₃COOCH₂CH₂CH(CH₃)CH₃＋H₂O（H⁺、heat）。乙酸＋3-甲基-1-丁醇 ⇌ 乙酸3-甲基丁酯＋水；式C₇H₁₄O₂。
review.en: Ethanoic acid + 3-methylbutan-1-ol ⇌ 3-methylbutyl ethanoate + water, with H+ and heat. Formula C7H14O2.

title.en: Separate the two sides at the ester group

text.zh: 羰基左边CH₃属于酸侧；桥氧右边长链与支链都属于醇侧。
text.en: The left CH3 is acid-derived; the longer chain and its branch beyond O are alcohol-derived.

text.zh: 羰基C为酸侧1号，左CH₃为2号；不能把醇侧支链号3接着酸侧编号。
text.en: Carbonyl C is acid-side1 and the left CH3 is2. Alcohol-side locants use a separate numbering system.

text.zh: 依次CH₂(1)—CH₂(2)—CH(3)—CH₃(4)；3号CH向下另接CH₃，故3-methylbutyl，不是2-methylbutyl。
text.en: Read CH2(1)—CH2(2)—CH(3)—CH3(4), with the lower CH3 on carbon3: 3-methylbutyl, not 2-methylbutyl.

text.zh: 醇侧5碳、酸侧2碳，总7碳。原料醇为3-methylbutan-1-ol；不凭香蕉味确定结构。
text.en: Five alcohol-side plus two acid-side carbons give7 total. The alcohol is 3-methylbutan-1-ol; odour is not proof of structure.

topic.zh: p66练习12(a)：酸侧三碳、醇侧两碳
topic.en: Page66 Practice12(a): three plus two carbons

lessons.reference: 教材印刷p66 Practice12(a)；原创命名与原料解析

breakdown.zh: CH₃CH₂CO—的3碳包括CO中的碳，给propanoate；—OCH₂CH₃给ethyl。总5碳不能替代酸侧3碳的词根。
breakdown.en: CH3CH2CO— has three acid-side carbons including its carbonyl and gives propanoate. —OCH2CH3 gives ethyl. Five total carbons do not change the acid root.

review.zh: CH₃CH₂COOH＋CH₃CH₂OH ⇌ CH₃CH₂COOCH₂CH₃＋H₂O（H⁺、heat）。丙酸＋乙醇 ⇌ 丙酸乙酯＋水。酸侧3、醇侧2、总5。
review.en: Propanoic acid + ethanol ⇌ ethyl propanoate + water, with H+ and heat. Acid side3, alcohol side2, total5.

text.zh: 同一C上方双键O、右侧单键O，再接碳链；不把它读成羧酸。
text.en: The same C joins double O above and single O to the right, followed by carbon: an ester rather than an acid.

text.zh: 羰基C(1)—CH₂(2)—CH₃(3)为propanoate，O之后不再接着数。
text.en: Carbonyl C(1)—CH2(2)—CH3(3) gives propanoate. Do not continue through oxygen.

title.en: Identify ethyl on the alcohol side

text.zh: O—CH₂—CH₃对应乙醇，给英文第一部分ethyl。
text.en: O—CH2—CH3 corresponds to ethanol and supplies the first English component, ethyl.

text.zh: 从酯反推丙酸和乙醇；不要误选乙酸和1-丙醇，那会得到另一种连接。
text.en: Recover propanoic acid and ethanol, not ethanoic acid and propan-1-ol, which give different connectivity.

topic.zh: p66练习12(c)：甲酸一碳与丁基四碳
topic.en: Page66 Practice12(c): methanoate plus butyl

lessons.reference: 教材印刷p66 Practice12(c)；原创横排展开与原料解析

breakdown.zh: methanoate酸侧只有H—C(=O)这1碳；butyl是O后连续4碳，从O连CH₂开始。丁基不意味着酸侧是丁酸。
breakdown.en: Methanoate has one acid-side carbon, H—C(=O). Butyl is the four-carbon chain beyond O, attached through CH2. Butyl does not mean butanoic acid.

review.zh: HCOOH＋HOCH₂CH₂CH₂CH₃ ⇌ HCOOCH₂CH₂CH₂CH₃＋H₂O（H⁺、heat）。甲酸＋1-丁醇 ⇌ 甲酸丁酯＋水；总式C₅H₁₀O₂。
review.en: Methanoic acid + butan-1-ol ⇌ butyl methanoate + water, with H+ and heat. Formula C5H10O2.

text.zh: 羰基C左边H与上方O、右方桥氧一起满足四价，不要把H换成CH₃。
text.en: H on the left, double O above and bridge O on the right complete carbonyl C valence. Do not replace H with CH3.

text.zh: 数酸侧不跨O，因此只有羰基C，对应甲酸。
text.en: The acid-side count stops at O and includes only the carbonyl carbon, corresponding to methanoic acid.

text.zh: O后为CH₂—CH₂—CH₂—CH₃，原料醇为1-丁醇，不是2-丁醇。
text.en: O joins CH2—CH2—CH2—CH3, corresponding to butan-1-ol, not butan-2-ol.

text.zh: butyl先写，methanoate后写；核对酸侧1＋醇侧4＝总5，中文甲酸丁酯。
text.en: Write butyl before methanoate and check1 acid-side+4 alcohol-side=5 total carbons.

topic.zh: p66练习12(d)／p68 q3(b)：先辨乙酸与丙醇
topic.en: Practice12(d) / page68 q3(b): ethanoate and propyl

lessons.reference: 教材印刷p65命名示例 / p66 Practice12(d) / p68 q3(b)；合并相同结构

breakdown.zh: CH₃CO—给ethanoate，—OCH₂CH₂CH₃给propyl。英文不是ethyl propanoate；后者酸侧3碳、醇侧2碳，虽然总式相同。
breakdown.en: CH3CO— gives ethanoate and —OCH2CH2CH3 gives propyl. Ethyl propanoate instead has three acid-side and two alcohol-side carbons, despite the same molecular formula.

review.zh: CH₃COOH＋HOCH₂CH₂CH₃ ⇌ CH₃COOCH₂CH₂CH₃＋H₂O（H⁺、heat）。乙酸＋1-丙醇 ⇌ 乙酸丙酯＋水；总碳2＋3＝5。
review.en: Ethanoic acid + propan-1-ol ⇌ propyl ethanoate + water, with H+ and heat. Two acid-side plus three alcohol-side carbons give5 total.

text.zh: C(=O)—O将左侧乙酸部分与右侧三碳醇部分分开。
text.en: C(=O)—O separates the ethanoic-acid-derived left side from the three-carbon alcohol-derived right side.

text.zh: 羰基C加左边CH₃为2碳；乙酸的ethanoic acid改为ethanoate。
text.en: Carbonyl C plus the left CH3 gives2; ethanoic acid becomes ethanoate.

text.zh: O后CH₂—CH₂—CH₃来自1-丙醇，给propyl。
text.en: O—CH2—CH2—CH3 comes from propan-1-ol and gives propyl.

text.zh: 把酸侧2与醇侧3核对后合名；不能只凭全分子5碳判断两侧。
text.en: Combine only after checking acid side2 and alcohol side3; total carbon count alone does not identify the two sides.

topic.zh: p68 q1(a)：两侧都三碳仍要分酸醇
topic.en: Page68 q1(a): distinguish two three-carbon sides

lessons.reference: 教材印刷p68 Section1.7 Questions1(a)；原创酯基展开

breakdown.zh: propanoate的3碳是羰基C＋CH₂＋CH₃；propyl的3碳是O后CH₂＋CH₂＋CH₃。同为3碳，不代表两侧碳的氢数和官能环境相同。
breakdown.en: Propanoate counts carbonyl C+CH2+CH3; propyl counts CH2+CH2+CH3 beyond O. Both sides have3 carbons but different hydrogen counts and environments.

review.zh: CH₃CH₂COOH＋HOCH₂CH₂CH₃ ⇌ CH₃CH₂COOCH₂CH₂CH₃＋H₂O（H⁺、heat）。丙酸＋1-丙醇 ⇌ 丙酸丙酯＋水；总碳6，酸侧母体3。
review.en: Propanoic acid + propan-1-ol ⇌ propyl propanoate + water, with H+ and heat. Six total carbons, three acid-parent carbons.

text.zh: 先定位C(=O)—O再分两侧，不能只凭整个横排长度叫己酸衍生物。
text.en: Locate C(=O)—O before counting either side; the full horizontal length is not a hexanoic-acid parent.

title.en: Include carbonyl C in the three-carbon acid side

text.zh: C(1)—CH₂(2)—CH₃(3)给propanoate，不是把左边两碳误叫ethanoate。
text.en: C(1)—CH2(2)—CH3(3) gives propanoate, not ethanoate based only on the two alkyl carbons.

title.en: Three carbons beyond O give propyl

text.zh: 右边CH₂—CH₂—CH₃来自1-丙醇；O不算碳。
text.en: The right CH2—CH2—CH3 comes from propan-1-ol; O is not counted as carbon.

text.zh: 第一个propyl表示醇侧，第二个propanoate表示酸侧；酸和醇不是同一个物质。
text.en: Propyl names the alcohol-derived group and propanoate the acid-derived group; propanol and propanoic acid are different compounds.

breakdown.zh: methyl是桥氧后的CH₃；benzoate是苯环直接接羰基C。不要把苯甲酸误拆成苯酚，也不要把环外羰基碳算入六边形。

review.zh: C₆H₅COOH＋CH₃OH ⇌ C₆H₅COOCH₃＋H₂O（H⁺、heat）。苯甲酸＋甲醇 ⇌ 苯甲酸甲酯＋水。p68 q3(c)由原料写产物，q4(c)由产物反推原料；总式C₈H₈O₂。
review.en: Benzoic acid + methanol ⇌ methyl benzoate + water, with H+ and heat. Page68 q3(c) asks for the product; q4(c) asks for its reactants. Formula C8H8O2.

text.zh: 从苯环出来先到羰基C，之后才是O与CH₃；不能交换C与O的先后。
text.en: Leaving the ring reaches carbonyl C before O and CH3. Do not swap the C and O positions.

text.zh: O—CH₃给methyl，醇为CH₃OH；没有额外CH₂，不是苄醇。

text.zh: 甲酸与乙醇
text.en: Methanoic acid and ethanol

text.zh: 乙酸与甲醇
text.en: Ethanoic acid and methanol

text.zh: 丙酸与水
text.en: Propanoic acid and water

text.zh: 乙醛与甲醇
text.en: Ethanal and methanol

explanation.zh: CH₃C(=O)是含酸碳的乙酸侧，O—CH₃是甲醇侧。CH₃COOH＋CH₃OH ⇌ CH₃COOCH₃＋H₂O（H⁺、heat）。错选甲酸＋乙醇会得到HCOOCH₂CH₃，虽同分子式，却不是同一连接。
explanation.en: CH3C(=O) is ethanoic-acid-derived and O—CH3 methanol-derived. CH3COOH + CH3OH ⇌ CH3COOCH3 + H2O with H+ and heat. Methanoic acid plus ethanol instead gives the structural isomer HCOOCH2CH3.

prompt.zh: 哪一组中英文名称与结构全部匹配？
prompt.en: Which English/Chinese pair and structures all match?

text.zh: methyl ethanoate＝甲酸乙酯＝HCOOCH₂CH₃
text.en: Methyl ethanoate = 甲酸乙酯 = HCOOCH2CH3

text.zh: ethyl methanoate＝乙酸甲酯＝CH₃COOCH₃
text.en: Ethyl methanoate = 乙酸甲酯 = CH3COOCH3

text.zh: 两种名字都表示同一结构
text.en: Both names denote the same connectivity

text.zh: methyl ethanoate＝乙酸甲酯＝CH₃COOCH₃；ethyl methanoate＝甲酸乙酯＝HCOOCH₂CH₃
text.en: Methyl ethanoate = 乙酸甲酯 = CH3COOCH3; ethyl methanoate = 甲酸乙酯 = HCOOCH2CH3

explanation.zh: 英文先醇侧alkyl后酸侧oate，中文先酸后醇。CH₃COOH＋CH₃OH ⇌ CH₃COOCH₃＋H₂O；HCOOH＋CH₃CH₂OH ⇌ HCOOCH₂CH₃＋H₂O（均为H⁺、heat）。换词对应换两侧连接，不是两个同义名。
explanation.en: English puts alcohol-derived alkyl before acid-derived oate, whereas Chinese puts the acid part first. The two acid/alcohol pairings give CH3COOCH3 and HCOOCH2CH3 respectively under acid catalysis and heat. They are not synonyms.

prompt.zh: 甲酸与乙醇对应的酯应画成哪一个？

text.zh: H—C(=O)—O—CH₂—CH₃
text.en: H—C(=O)—O—CH2—CH3

text.zh: CH₃—C(=O)—O—CH₃
text.en: CH3—C(=O)—O—CH3

text.zh: CH₃CH₂—C(=O)—OH
text.en: CH3CH2—C(=O)—OH

text.zh: CH₃—O—CH₂CH₃
text.en: CH3—O—CH2CH3

explanation.zh: HCOOH＋CH₃CH₂OH ⇌ HCOOCH₂CH₃＋H₂O（H⁺、heat）。酸侧只有1个羰基碳，剩下一价连H。b把酸侧错换成乙酸且醇侧错换成甲醇；c还是酸，d没有C=O而是醚。
explanation.en: HCOOH + CH3CH2OH ⇌ HCOOCH2CH3 + H2O with H+ and heat. Its acid side has only one C with an attached H. Option b swaps both sides, c remains an acid and d is an ether without C=O.

prompt.zh: 下图的酸侧母体碳数、醇侧碳数及对应原料是哪一组？

text.en: Acid2, alcohol4; ethanoic acid and butan-1-ol

text.zh: 酸侧6、醇侧0；己酸与水
text.en: Acid6, alcohol0; hexanoic acid and water

text.zh: 酸侧4、醇侧2；丁酸与乙醇
text.en: Acid4, alcohol2; butanoic acid and ethanol

text.zh: 酸侧3、醇侧3；丙酸与1-丙醇
text.en: Acid3, alcohol3; propanoic acid and propan-1-ol

explanation.zh: 酸侧CH₃CH₂CH₂C(=O)含4碳，O后CH₂CH₃含2碳。CH₃CH₂CH₂COOH＋CH₃CH₂OH ⇌ CH₃CH₂CH₂COOCH₂CH₃＋H₂O（H⁺、heat）。总6碳不能判定酸醇分配，更不能跨O选母体。
explanation.en: CH3CH2CH2C(=O) has4 acid-side carbons and O—CH2CH3 has2 alcohol-side carbons. Butanoic acid + ethanol ⇌ ethyl butanoate + water with H+ and heat. Six total carbons do not determine how the two sides are allocated.

text.en: Ethanoic acid + phenol ⇌ ethyl benzoate + water

text.zh: 苯甲酸＋乙醇 ⇌ 苯甲酸乙酯＋水
text.en: Benzoic acid + ethanol ⇌ ethyl benzoate + water

text.zh: 苯甲酸＋甲醇 ⇌ 苯甲酸乙酯＋水
text.en: Benzoic acid + methanol ⇌ ethyl benzoate + water

text.zh: 苯甲酸＋1-丙醇 ⇌ 苯甲酸乙酯＋水
text.en: Benzoic acid + propan-1-ol ⇌ ethyl benzoate + water

explanation.zh: C₆H₅COOH＋CH₃CH₂OH ⇌ C₆H₅COOCH₂CH₃＋H₂O（H⁺、heat）。methyl和propyl分别需要甲醇和1-丙醇；苯酚那一侧是O—苯环，不是这里的苯环—C(=O)。
explanation.en: C6H5COOH + CH3CH2OH ⇌ C6H5COOCH2CH3 + H2O with H+ and heat. Methanol and propan-1-ol would supply methyl and propyl instead. Phenol-derived esters put the ring beyond O, not directly on C=O.

title.zh: 练习11(c)／12(b)：丁酸甲酯互相核对

prompt.zh: CH₃CH₂CH₂COOCH₃的英文名及原料，哪组正确？

text.en: Butyl methanoate; methanoic acid + butan-1-ol

text.zh: ethyl propanoate；丙酸＋乙醇
text.en: Ethyl propanoate; propanoic acid + ethanol

text.zh: methyl pentanoate；戊酸＋甲醇
text.en: Methyl pentanoate; pentanoic acid + methanol

text.zh: methyl butanoate；丁酸＋甲醇
text.en: Methyl butanoate; butanoic acid + methanol

explanation.zh: 酸侧含羰基碳共4，醇侧只有O—CH₃。CH₃CH₂CH₂COOH＋CH₃OH ⇌ CH₃CH₂CH₂COOCH₃＋H₂O（H⁺、heat）。a、b虽可与它同为5碳，却有不同连接；c把醇侧碳误加进酸母体。

title.zh: 练习11(d)：异戊基的支链到底在哪？

prompt.zh: 制备3-methylbutyl ethanoate时，对应的醇结构是哪一个？
prompt.en: Which alcohol corresponds to 3-methylbutyl ethanoate?

text.zh: HOCH₂CH₂CH(CH₃)CH₃：3-甲基-1-丁醇

text.zh: HOCH₂CH(CH₃)CH₂CH₃：2-甲基-1-丁醇

text.zh: HOCH₂CH₂CH₂CH₂CH₃：1-戊醇

explanation.zh: 目标名为phenyl ethanoate（乙酸苯酯），连接CH₃C(=O)—O—C₆H₅。CH₃COOH＋C₆H₅OH ⇌ CH₃COOC₆H₅＋H₂O仅作形式组成核对，不承诺醋与苯酚直接有效制备；可行酰化的反应式例如(CH₃CO)₂O＋C₆H₅OH → CH₃COOC₆H₅＋CH₃COOH。phenyl直接接环，benzyl另含CH₂；这里不提供实验步骤。
explanation.en: The intended product is phenyl ethanoate, CH3C(=O)—O—C6H5. Acid + phenol ⇌ ester + water is only a formal composition relationship, not a claim of effective direct preparation from vinegar. An activated-acyl equation is (CH3CO)2O + C6H5OH → CH3COOC6H5 + CH3COOH. Phenyl has no benzyl CH2; no procedure is supplied.

prompt.en: Which structure and name correspond to formic acid and CH3CH(OH)CH2CH3?

text.zh: HCOOCH(CH₃)CH₂CH₃；butan-2-yl methanoate（甲酸仲丁酯）
text.en: HCOOCH(CH3)CH2CH3; butan-2-yl methanoate

text.zh: HCOOCH₂CH₂CH₂CH₃；butyl methanoate（甲酸正丁酯）
text.en: HCOOCH2CH2CH2CH3; butyl methanoate

text.zh: CH₃COOCH₂CH₂CH₃；propyl ethanoate
text.en: CH3COOCH2CH2CH3; propyl ethanoate

text.zh: CH₃CH₂CH₂COOCH₃；methyl butanoate
text.en: CH3CH2CH2COOCH3; methyl butanoate

explanation.zh: HCOOH＋CH₃CH(OH)CH₂CH₃ ⇌ HCOOCH(CH₃)CH₂CH₃＋H₂O（H⁺、heat）。醇中O接哪个碳，酯中仍接哪个碳：本题接带CH₃与CH₂CH₃的CH。b偷偷把2-丁醇改成1-丁醇；平面式未指定唯一立体构型。
explanation.en: HCOOH + CH3CH(OH)CH2CH3 ⇌ HCOOCH(CH3)CH2CH3 + H2O with H+ and heat. O stays attached to the secondary CH carrying CH3 and CH2CH3. Normal butyl instead requires butan-1-ol; no unique stereochemistry is specified.

prompt.zh: CH₃CH₂C(=O)OCH₂CH₂CH₂CH₂CH₃对应哪一对酸醇？
prompt.en: Which acid and alcohol correspond to CH3CH2C(=O)OCH2CH2CH2CH2CH3?

text.zh: 戊酸与1-丙醇
text.en: Pentanoic acid and propan-1-ol

text.zh: 乙酸与1-己醇
text.en: Ethanoic acid and hexan-1-ol

text.zh: 丁酸与1-丁醇
text.en: Butanoic acid and butan-1-ol

text.zh: 丙酸与1-戊醇
text.en: Propanoic acid and pentan-1-ol

explanation.zh: 酸侧3碳含羰基C，醇侧O后5碳：产物pentyl propanoate（丙酸戊酯）。CH₃CH₂COOH＋HOCH₂CH₂CH₂CH₂CH₃ ⇌ CH₃CH₂COOCH₂CH₂CH₂CH₂CH₃＋H₂O（H⁺、heat）。各选项总碳都可为8，必须先按O分两侧。
explanation.en: There are3 acid-side carbons including C=O and5 beyond O: pentyl propanoate. Propanoic acid + pentan-1-ol ⇌ this ester + water with H+ and heat. All offered allocations can total8 carbons, so split at O first.

prompt.en: Which alcohol is recovered from CH3CH2C(=O)OCH2CH(CH2CH3)CH2CH2CH3?

text.zh: 3-乙基-1-戊醇／3-ethylpentan-1-ol
text.en: 3-Ethylpentan-1-ol

text.zh: 2-乙基-1-戊醇／2-ethylpentan-1-ol
text.en: 2-Ethylpentan-1-ol

text.zh: 2-甲基-1-戊醇／2-methylpentan-1-ol
text.en: 2-Methylpentan-1-ol

text.zh: 1-庚醇／heptan-1-ol
text.en: Heptan-1-ol

explanation.zh: 从连O的CH₂为1，下一CH为2并连CH₂CH₃乙基；含OH碳的最长醇母体为5碳，不可把总7碳拉成直链。CH₃CH₂COOH＋HOCH₂CH(CH₂CH₃)CH₂CH₂CH₃ ⇌ CH₃CH₂COOCH₂CH(CH₂CH₃)CH₂CH₂CH₃＋H₂O（H⁺、heat）。产物为2-ethylpentyl propanoate（丙酸2-乙基戊酯）。
explanation.en: The O-attached CH2 is1 and the next CH is2 with a CH2CH3 branch. The longest alcohol parent containing the OH-bearing carbon has5 carbons, not7 in a straight line. Propanoic acid + 2-ethylpentan-1-ol ⇌ 2-ethylpentyl propanoate + water with H+ and heat.

title.zh: p63练习3：草酸需要怎样的醇？
title.en: Page63 Practice3: which alcohol gives oxalic acid?

prompt.zh: 保留原有两个碳，并把两端伯醇都氧化成COOH，哪组起始物与形式净式正确？
prompt.en: Retain two original carbons while oxidizing both primary-alcohol ends to COOH. Which starting compound and formal net equation fit?

text.zh: 乙醇；CH₃CH₂OH＋[O] → HOOC—COOH
text.en: Ethanol; CH3CH2OH + [O] → HOOC—COOH

text.zh: 乙二醇；HOCH₂CH₂OH＋[O] → HOOC—COOH
text.en: Ethane-1,2-diol; HOCH2CH2OH + [O] → HOOC—COOH

text.zh: 乙二醇；HOCH₂CH₂OH＋4[O] → HOOC—COOH＋2H₂O
text.en: Ethane-1,2-diol; HOCH2CH2OH + 4[O] → HOOC—COOH + 2H2O

text.zh: 2-丙醇；CH₃CH(OH)CH₃＋[O] → HOOC—COOH
text.en: Propan-2-ol; CH3CH(OH)CH3 + [O] → HOOC—COOH

explanation.zh: 乙二醇ethane-1,2-diol的两个CH₂OH端都可形式上经醛氧化到COOH，产物ethanedioic acid（草酸）。总计需4[O]并形成2H₂O才平衡。乙醇的常规伯醇氧化终点是乙酸而非直接把CH₃也改成酸；[O]为当量标记，不是实验配方。
explanation.en: Both CH2OH ends of ethane-1,2-diol can oxidize through aldehyde stages to ethanedioic acid. The formal balance requires4[O] and2H2O. Ordinary primary-alcohol oxidation of ethanol gives ethanoic acid, not direct conversion of its CH3 into another COOH. [O] denotes equivalents, not a recipe.

title.zh: 多羧酸：母体碳和羧基碳何时合计？
title.en: Polycarboxylic acids: parent and carboxyl counts

prompt.zh: 哪组计数同时正确？柠檬酸按2-hydroxypropane-1,2,3-tricarboxylic acid理解。
prompt.en: Which counts are correct, using 2-hydroxypropane-1,2,3-tricarboxylic acid for citric acid?

text.zh: propanedioic acid母体3碳；柠檬酸propane母体3碳、全分子6碳
text.en: Propanedioic acid: parent3; citric acid: propane parent3, total6

text.zh: propanedioic acid母体1碳；柠檬酸总3碳
text.en: Propanedioic acid: parent1; citric acid: total3

text.zh: 两种名称的所有COOH碳都不计入母体
text.en: Both names exclude all COOH carbons from their parents

text.zh: 两种名称词根碳数都必等于全分子碳数
text.en: Both parent roots must equal total molecular carbons

explanation.zh: HOOC—CH₂—COOH的-dioic命名把两端酸碳计入3碳母体；tricarboxylic写法把3个COOH接在另一个3碳propane母体上，合计6。可用反应核对官能团数：HOOC—CH₂—COOH＋2NaOH → NaOOC—CH₂—COONa＋2H₂O，两个COOH各消耗1OH⁻。
explanation.en: The dioic parent in HOOC—CH2—COOH includes both carboxyl carbons. The tricarboxylic form attaches three COOH groups to a separate three-carbon propane parent. Functional-group counting also gives HOOC—CH2—COOH + 2NaOH → NaOOC—CH2—COONa + 2H2O, one hydroxide per COOH.

title.zh: 酯的性质：选有条件的表述
title.en: Ester properties: choose the qualified statement

quizzes.reference: 教材p66性质段落；纠正绝对化和常温气态说法

prompt.zh: 对没有额外OH／NH的普通酯，哪一项正确？
prompt.en: For an ordinary ester without an additional OH or NH group, which statement is correct?

text.zh: 两个O会使酯彼此提供OH型氢键，故所有酯都易溶于水
text.en: Two O atoms let esters donate OH-type H bonds to each other, so all esters are water-soluble

text.zh: 没有OH就完全没有极性，也不能与水形成氢键
text.en: Without OH an ester is completely nonpolar and cannot H-bond with water

text.zh: 低分子酯常温全部为气体，闻到气味就能定名
text.en: All small esters are gases at room temperature and odour uniquely identifies them

text.zh: 酯有极性、可接受水的氢键，但酯基本身无OH供体；不少小酯是挥发性液体
text.en: Esters are polar and accept H bonds from water but lack an ester OH donor; many small esters are volatile liquids

explanation.zh: 羰基与C—O让酯有极性，O可接受水的氢键；无OH供体不等于完全不能氢键。较大烃部分通常降低水溶性，物态与沸点还受具体结构和温度影响。气味不是结构证明，且本版ethyl butanoate的banana／pineapple标签互相冲突，不设成唯一记忆答案。
explanation.en: C=O and C—O make esters polar and their O atoms accept H bonds from water. Lacking an OH donor does not mean no H bonding. Hydrocarbon size, structure and temperature affect solubility and phase. Odour cannot prove connectivity; this edition's conflicting banana/pineapple labels for ethyl butanoate are not assessed as a unique fact.
